title: 第10章 熊孩子之间的战斗友谊
slug: 帝国的崛起全本免费-帝国的崛起最新章节列表
content_zh:
如果鲁普雷希特能看到眼前的场景的话，一定能认出这个被众星捧月一般围在中央的人是谁！如果说德国内还有哪个家族能稳压自己一头的话，那么只有眼前的这个家族，没错，这个人就是霍亨索伦家族下一任族长、未来的德皇威廉二世、目前被称为威廉皇太子的人！
历史上威廉二世曾经在一张电报纸上架空了一艘2000吨的小号巡洋舰而被人喷的一无是处。而这个位面，威廉二世此时并没有登上德意志的皇位，而在架空这个爱好领域，他走的更远，在自己的小船折戟沉沙之后，不甘心的皇太子殿下又架空了一艘更大的战舰。然后化名发到了报纸上！
于是乎，出现了刚才的一幕！这种违反了德国海军设计常识的战舰自然遭到了一些“有识之士”的强烈反对和嘲讽，匿名装B不成反而被一顿乱棍打回来的皇太子陛下感觉自己相当的没面子。正考虑是不是采取一些非常手段的时候，穿越者的文章犹如一碗心灵的鸡汤一般让他整个人舒服的不要不要的！
鲁普雷希特这样做可不仅仅是因为找到了一个志趣相投的人。更重要的是为即将到来的某人作势！虽然无论德国海军这波扩张最后情况如何，巴伐利亚王室都会赚到自己应该得到的那一份利润，但是人总是不知道满足的。在装甲供应谈妥之后，王子殿下感觉无论是为了德国海军的未来，还是为了让自己的腰包更鼓一些，自己的船舶设计局也应该加快脚步了，毕竟某人已经决定来到德国任职，而且船舶设计的利润确实很大！从大的方面来讲，自己现在是与德意志利益休戚与共，有责任改变一些东西，从小的方面来说，钱是好东西。不挣是傻子。
某人的设计确实NB，但是前提是能获得德国海军的认可，世界上有多少好东西是设计相当不错，结果被官僚们直接扔一边了的？帝国海军毕竟是普鲁士为首的中央政府主导，不是你家的。所以自己必须做好相关工作，其中造势就是最重要的一点。后世叫炒作，商业上叫推广，网络上叫嘴炮。先让人们对某个概念有一个印象，然后再看某人的技术和巴伐利亚王国的公关能力是否过关了！
王子本来打算帮一把就走的，自己定下基调，造势工作交给别人做就行了，自己该忙啥忙啥去。结果这事一开始，就向着某种未知的方向发展！一天，一名内侍送来了一封信，而这封信的落款正好是那个黑鹰之主的家伙！
“这神通有些广大啊，能找到我这里来！”鲁普雷希特感叹道，投稿这事自然不是自己亲自做，让一个下属自己处理就行了，结果这哥们直接通过报社找到了投稿人，然后给自己塞了这么一封信，估计这封信到自己手中至少经过了两手。的穿越者感到有些不太舒服..。
信中的大意很简单，就是，小伙子很不错，很有想法。那些攻击我们的混蛋太猖狂了，他们的无知和狂妄让老子很生气。而你和我很对脾气，咱们想想办法继续把嘴炮打下去，打赢了，我给你好处！
“打赢的好处还用你给？老子以后收入水平是要超越克虏伯的！老子要的好处你能给？”鲁普雷希特对这封外表拉风，霸气到让人不舒服的信嗤之以鼻。不过最后落款上加盖的印章让他不得不对这封信的人重视起来，因为这家伙是黑鹰骑士团的！德意志顶尖贵族机构！
黑鹰骑士团是什么？一般人不知道，但现在在德国内部可谓是家喻户晓，说是德国最顶尖的贵族组织那是一点都不过分的！骑士团的团长一般就是现任德皇！而老毛奇一干人都是其中的成员！而且这个贵族团体的人非常少，在历史上威廉二世上台之前，整个骑士团只有81名在职的贵族！想想吧，排除那些霍亨索伦家族的王子王孙们，剩下的人能入选的那都是最顶尖的存在啊！

content_en:
If Ruprecht could see the scene in front of him, he would definitely recognize who the man in the center was surrounded by stars! If there is any family in Germany that can stabilize itself, then only the family in front of you. Yes, this person is the next patriarch of the Hohenzollern family, the future Kaiser Wilhelm II, and the person currently known as Crown Prince Wilhelm!
Historically, Wilhelm II once aired a 2,000-ton small cruiser in a telegraph newspaper and was criticized for being useless. In this dimension, Wilhelm II did not ascend the throne of Germany at this time, but in the field of evasion, he went further. After his own boat broke down and sank in the sand, His Royal Highness the Crown Prince was unwilling to evacuate a larger warship. Then the pseudonym was published in the newspaper!
Ever since, the scene just now happened! This kind of warship that violated the common sense of German naval design naturally encountered strong opposition and ridicule from some "people of insight". His Majesty the Crown Prince, who failed to pretend to be anonymous but was beaten back with a stick, felt quite embarrassed. Just when he was considering whether to take some extraordinary measures, the traveler's article was like a bowl of chicken soup for the soul, making him feel so comfortable that he couldn't help but want it!
Ruprecht did this not just because he found a kindred spirit. What’s more important is setting the stage for someone to come! Although no matter what the final situation of this wave of German naval expansion is, the Bavarian royal family will make its share of profits, but people are never satisfied. After the armor supply was negotiated, His Royal Highness felt that whether it was for the future of the German Navy or to make his own pockets bigger, his ship design bureau should also speed up. After all, someone has decided to come to Germany to work, and ship design is indeed very profitable! From a large perspective, I now share weal and woe with Germany's interests and have the responsibility to change some things. From a small perspective, money is a good thing. If you don’t earn it, you are a fool.
Someone's design is indeed awesome, but the prerequisite is that it can be approved by the German Navy. How many good things in the world have very good designs, but are simply thrown aside by the bureaucrats? After all, the Imperial Navy is led by the central government headed by Prussia, not yours. Therefore, you must do relevant work, of which building momentum is the most important point. In later generations, it is called hype, in business it is called promotion, and on the Internet it is called talk. Let people have an impression of a certain concept first, and then see whether someone's technology and the Kingdom of Bavaria's public relations ability pass the test!
The prince originally planned to help and leave, setting the tone himself, leaving the momentum building work to others, and doing whatever he should be busy with. As a result, from the moment it started, it developed in an unknown direction! One day, a chamberlain sent a letter, and the letter happened to be signed by that guy from the Lord of the Black Eagle!
"This magical power is quite powerful. You can find me here!" Ruprecht exclaimed. Naturally, he did not do the submission himself. He just asked a subordinate to handle it. As a result, this guy found the contributor directly through the newspaper office, and then stuffed himself with such a letter. It is estimated that this letter passed through at least two hands in his hands. The traveler felt a little uncomfortable...
The main idea of ​​the letter is very simple, that is, the young man is very good and has great ideas. Those bastards who attacked us are so arrogant. Their ignorance and arrogance make me very angry. And you and I have very different tempers. Let’s find a way to keep the fight going. If we win, I’ll give you benefits!
"Why should you give me the benefits of winning? My income level will surpass Krupp's in the future! Can you give me the benefits I want?" Ruprecht sneered at this letter, which looked so cool and domineering that it made people uncomfortable. However, the seal added to the final signature made him pay attention to the person who wrote the letter, because thisThis guy is from the Black Hawk Knights! Germany's top aristocratic institution!
What are the Black Hawk Knights? Most people don't know it, but it is now a household name in Germany. It is not an exaggeration to say that it is the top aristocratic organization in Germany! The leader of the Knights is usually the current Kaiser! And Lao Maoqi and the others are all members of it! Moreover, there are very few people in this noble group. Before William II came to power in history, there were only 81 serving nobles in the entire Knights! Think about it, excluding the princes and grandsons of the Hohenzollern family, the remaining people who can be selected are the top beings!
